java_location_details.role: Builds the TIM output iterator with long-comment, short-comment, and inline-comment filters before plain lines enter the preprocessed result.
Consumes COMMENT_SIMPLE lines instead of returning them to the preprocessed result.
Hashes only lines surviving TIM into the deterministic SVG resource seed.

rust_location_details.role: Uses normal preprocessing for parser lines, but reconstructs theme seed source directly from raw input and theme expansions, reintroducing user comment lines that TIM removed.

invariant: Deterministic SVG resource IDs are seeded from PlantUML's post-TIM UmlSource. TLineType and the long/short comment iterators remove full-line quote comments, whole-line /' ... '/ comments, and multiline /' ... '/ blocks. CodeIteratorInnerComment then applies StringLocated.removeInnerComment: a prefix /' ... '/ preserves code after the first closing token, a suffix preserves code before the last opening token, and /'''[-\w]*'''/ payloads are removed wherever they occur. An ordinary apostrophe after code is not a TIM comment and remains available to the diagram command parser; ordinary blank lines retain their identity. Theme expansion must not bypass those exact semantics.
causal_divergence: The accepted golden symptom remains narrow: the complex Cerulean override fixture agrees in geometry, colors, gradients, and paint order, but expanded_theme_seed_source copied a Java-classified full-line quote comment into the resource seed. The first implementation corrected that symptom but generalized from Rust's pre-existing strip_inline_comment helper, which is not the Java TIM model. It removed every whitespace-preceded ordinary apostrophe, discarded valid prefix inner-comment lines that carry code after '/, and retained Java's special /'''[-\w]*'''/ payloads. The independent checker demonstrated all three divergences on fresh valid inputs: the ordinary apostrophe changed whether a skinparam command was valid, the prefix form changed entity order/source metadata, and the special form remained visibly rendered. The normal preprocessing stream and theme seed reconstruction therefore need one shared, exact TIM comment transformation rather than separate heuristics.
planned_change: Introduce one comment-stream transformation matching TLineType plus CodeIteratorLongComment, CodeIteratorShortComment, and StringLocated.removeInnerComment. Use it both in PreprocessContext's ordinary line stream and expanded_theme_seed_source. Remove the global whitespace-apostrophe stripping path so ordinary trailing apostrophes survive TIM exactly as Java does. Preserve source-line placeholders for fully consumed comment lines, preserve prefix/suffix code on their original source line, remove every Java-matching /'''[-\w]*'''/ payload without fixture-specific branches, and keep EBNF terminal syntax untouched. Replace the overbroad unit assertion with independent cases for full-line, multiline, whole-line, prefix, suffix, special triple, ordinary apostrophe, quoted apostrophe, and adjacent blank lines.
perturbation_axes: full-line quote versus whole-line and multiline /' comments
ordinary trailing apostrophes retained for command-level validation
comment before versus after theme expansion
comment-only changes versus renamed entities and changed topology
apostrophes inside quoted text versus actual inline comments
ordinary blank lines adjacent to removed comments
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns the shared post-TIM comment stream consumed both by parsing and UmlSource identity. It alters which text survives TIM, but does not decide whether a surviving ordinary apostrophe is valid for a particular diagram command. It does not alter theme contents, gradient tuple generation, resource ordering, layout, comparator behavior, golden data, or fixture eligibility.
acceptance: preproc_complex_theme_override uses PlantUML's expected gradient IDs and becomes structurally equivalent through render_svg without oracle input.
Fresh seed and parser tests prove full-line, long, whole-line, prefix, suffix, and special triple inner-comment behavior without changing ordinary blank-line identity.
Ordinary trailing apostrophes are retained by TIM; the checker skinparam input follows Java command-level behavior rather than being silently accepted after stripping.
Quoted apostrophes and EBNF terminal syntax are not misclassified as comments.
Existing source-identity and theme-expansion seed tests remain green.
The parser and renderer suites, clippy, full no-oracle ratchet, and frozen mechanical guards pass without family regressions.
An independent checker records a verdict at the exact implementation revision and preserves Java-generated held-outs when the Java oracle is available.
forbidden_approaches: matching the Cerulean theme, fixture labels, expected hash, or generated gradient IDs
removing ordinary blank lines or changing source line metadata
changing the global seed algorithm or resource ordering
comparator, eligibility, park-list, or golden changes

experimental_result.accepted_result: preproc_complex_theme_override becomes structurally equivalent through render_svg without oracle input. The frozen shipped-path census rises from 11,169/11,251 to 11,170/11,251, with preprocessing moving from 287/307 to 288/307 and every other family unchanged.
experimental_result.model_evidence: Removing only the Java-classified full-line comment from Rust's 7,465-byte reconstructed theme source changes the source seed from 1u17r8kq8jkal to the exact golden prefix 5uh6twufn3b0; no SVG paint or geometry change is involved. The implementation now applies Java's long-, short-, and inline-comment identity semantics while reconstructing a theme-expanded source. A fresh paired test proves that comments before and after a theme, a long comment, and an inline comment do not affect identity, while an apostrophe inside a quoted renamed label and an ordinary blank line survive.
experimental_result.review_status: Rejected by independent review commit fbf5f08562a37f6b05882a7cd4e8c95b031d190a: all three fresh Java-valid held-outs failed. The accepted golden gain remains evidence for the full-line comment symptom only; it does not attest the broader first implementation.
experimental_result.corrected_model_evidence: The shared tim_comment_line transformation now preserves ordinary apostrophes, preserves prefix and suffix code, removes Java's special triple-apostrophe payload, and drives both parser and seed streams. All 614 parser unit tests pass. On the three rejected held-outs, source identity, entity presence/order, visible payload removal, intrinsic text, deterministic resource IDs, and mechanism-owned geometry now agree with Java. Controlled token-free equivalents generated under /private/tmp reproduce every residual structural diff: class-shell left overscan, association-label theme styling, and the malformed legacy-skinparam style epoch are independent renderer mechanisms rather than comment-stream effects.
experimental_result.corrected_review_status: Awaiting a new independent checker review. The prior REJECT remains authoritative until the preserved held-outs pass or explicit user sign-off changes the rule.

review_rejection.required_correction: Replace the first implementation's broad inline-apostrophe heuristic with the exact Java TIM iterator and StringLocated.removeInnerComment model before requesting a new checker verdict.
